links.comparator_used: Clinicians reading CTA without AI assistance (same readers with vs without AI after a 4-week washout; randomised AI-assisted vs control group)
links.outcome: Clinician diagnostic performance (AUC, sensitivity) for intracranial aneurysm detection on CTA
links.effect: MRMC per-patient AUC 0·795 without AI vs 0·878 with AI (p<0·0001); randomised study AUC 0·858 vs 0·789 (p<0·0001); prospective AUC 0·787 to 0·909 and patient-level sensitivity 0·590 to 0·825 (p<0·0001); AI adoption rate 92·6%
links.tradeoff: Reading time fell slightly (87·5 s vs 82·7 s). The model had a 0·51% (8/1570) error rate from poor-quality CTA images and recognition failure.
links.quote: In the randomised open-label comparison study, clinicians in the AI-assisted group had a high acceptance of the AI model (92·6% adoption rate), and a higher AUC when compared with the control group (0·858 [95% CI 0·850-0·866] vs 0·789 [0·780-0·799]; p<0·0001).

design_hint: AI-assisted clinician reading with and without AI, plus prospective real-world deployment validation
